defaultPrompt: Forensically audit this system and design evidence-backed improvements.
interface.longDescription: A.S.F.R.E.E is a modular, evidence-driven orchestrator for authorized AI/software forensics, evaluation, diagnosis, comparison and supervised reconstruction. M00 coordinates canonical specialists O01–O12; O11 governs security and O12 evaluates evidence and impact. The 0.4.0-rc.1 candidate adds explicit P1.1 contracts for verified identity/MFA, signed cross-process delegation, SCIVE policy coverage, complete encryption scope, isolated execution, host-enforced quotas, external WORM audit, infrastructure tenant isolation, concurrency tests and independent human review. These are architecture and acceptance gates, not a claim of production deployment. The portable package remains skills and contracts only.
